```{ojs}
//| echo: false
mapDiv = {
  if (!scores.length) {
    yield html`<p style="text-align:center;color:gray;margin:3rem 0">Data for this survey is not available yet.</p>`;
    return;
  }
  const div = html`<div style="width:100%;aspect-ratio:${survey.aspect}"></div>`;
  yield div;
  const traces = buildMapTraces(scores, inclusion, domain, showExcluded, survey);
  await Plotly.newPlot(div, traces, mapLayout(domain, survey), {responsive: true, displaylogo: false});
  div.on("plotly_click", ev => {
    const p = ev.points[0];
    if (p.curveNumber > 1) return;               // excluded regions have no data page
    const row = scores.find(r => r.code === p.location);
    if (row) window.location.href = `region-data.html?survey=${survey.id}#${encodeURIComponent(row.region)}`;
  });
}
```

<p style="text-align:center;color:gray;font-size:0.9rem">Click a region to see its data.</p>
